product.olivetti-echos-p133c.summary: The Echos P133C was offered with two Pentium clock speeds.
product.olivetti-echos-p133c.history: Computerwoche documented the P133C in March 1997 after the range refresh. It reported around DM 3,000 and DM 3,500 for the 120 and 133 MHz versions.
product.olivetti-echos-p133c.architectur: The optical drive supported software on CD. The offer documents an 8× CD-ROM, a 1 GB disk and 8 MB RAM.
product.olivetti-echos-p133c.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-echos-p133c.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-echos-p133c.press: Computerwoche, 28 March 1997, Olivetti startet mit neuer Führung.
